snippet.title: The Sorting Bureau — Release Trailer | Cozy Sorting Game
snippet.description:
A cozy sorting game set in a quiet Tokyo workshop.

Clients bring you boxes of clutter: buttons, coins, gears, stamps. Sort, match, and piece everything together with satisfying ASMR clicks. No timers. No wrong answers. Just the joy of tidying up.

🔗 Wishlist on Steam: The Sorting Bureau

---

The Sorting Bureau is a meditative 2D sorting game where you work in a small workshop on the outskirts of Tokyo. Regular clients bring boxes full of chaos, and your job is to sort hundreds of tactile objects into labeled containers. Every item clicks, rustles, or clunks into place. Every desk tells a story about its owner.

No background music — only ambient sounds and ASMR. No stress mechanics — no timers, no scores, no penalties. Just you, a cup of tea, and the deep satisfaction of perfect order.

Developed by apelsinka games 🍊
